summary: P08 states 20 of 26 sub-steps. All of the bank-exchange network (4/4), the matrix shear (4/4) and the simultaneous layer (5/5) are present. Of the label-residual budget only L3 and L5 are present: there is no residual table, no h-2 complement for the side edge 2->5, and no nonalternating or orthonormal-basis argument. The phase interface lacks the k-column tensoring (P3). The rank saving gives the deficit and the exponent bound but not the exact values η_b and η_c.
